rubrics.justification: It matches the reported 3AA in broad terms, but it likely over-interprets image details by asserting notable granularity, vacuolization, and TE irregularity that may not be reliably visible from a single embryo image.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor context, smoking, endometrium, and first-cycle status well, though some links (e.g., 100% MII as a strong implantation modifier) are somewhat overstated.
The structure is logical, but the probability adjustment scheme is somewhat arbitrary and the final estimate may be overly reduced by speculative image findings and smoking effect size.

SET recommendation, smoking cessation, and general prognosis framing are guideline-consistent, but routine aspirin, ERA after a single failure, and strong emphasis on PGT-A/SDF are not universally guideline-supported in this scenario.
Provides clear next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET and lifestyle modification, though some recommendations are more aggressive than standard practice for a first cycle.
